rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_supervised-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=3, proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005, img_kernel=5, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.02, epochs=30, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-4 dual_domain_bilateral_supervised, re-split Breast-CT val=200. SIX-BOX vs BEST (iter-3 img_n_bf=7/ep10 hr=0.2466). (1) PRIOR: BF-depth is now saturating -- img_n_bf 1->3 gave +0.027, 3->7 only +0.0035; every iter used ep=10 and <=~120s of the 20-min budget. (2) Failure mode: with 6-24 params but only 10 epochs, the tiny BF sigmas are likely UNDER-trained (few gradient passes over 400 scenes), not capacity-bound. (3) ONE KNOB: epochs 10 -> 30 (img_n_bf=7 held at best; lr/kernels/lambda_neg unchanged). (4) HYPOTHESIS: tripling epochs lets the BF sigmas converge further and lifts hr above 0.2466 toward ~0.26-0.28, because the sibling DD-UNet showed epochs was its dominant monotone lever and budget is nearly untouched. If flat, BF fit is saturated and iter-5 pivots to lr or img_kernel. (5) BUDGET: 3x ep at ~93s/10ep base -> ~280s, well inside 20 min. (6) Loop continues. Artifacts saved.
